positive.prompt: Finish first-time setup with the female Korean voice. Check and update Codex if required.
positive.expected: Checks Codex compatibility, performs an explicitly authorized update when needed, runs bundled setup with the open-hooks option, opens a new terminal, starts the verified Codex CLI there, and leaves /hooks entry, review, and trust to the user.
Maps the natural-language request to female and en, then changes only this plugin's preferences.

positive.expected: Changes only the plugin voice and language preferences.

discovery.purpose: Bilingual golden cases for plugin and skill selection only; they do not authorize installation, trust changes, or unrelated audio automation.
